invariants.rationale: Validates that the method's input is not null, as writeStatuses is dereferenced in HoodieListData.eager(writeStatuses).
Validates that the result parameter is not null, as result methods are called unconditionally in the method body.
The size of a list is always at least zero.
After execution, result.setWriteStatuses(statuses) is always called, ensuring the write statuses in result are set.
The method sets the index update duration in result, so this field should be non-null after method execution.
